name: 李東明
objective:
設計是造就其所處時代和文化下的產物。它是社會共有的價值觀體現，但設計的思考過程也用於代表特定的概念，鼓勵某些活動，從而影響社會和文化。本課程介紹現代和後現代設計的時代精神，涉及的重要發展包括建築、平面設計、產品設計、家具設計、室內設計、數字設計，甚至商業設計。本課程提供理解設計史上的精彩作品，透過政治、宗教、技術、文化、氣候和地理因素影響下的背景梳理。
Design is a product of the period and culture in which it is created. It is a representation of values shared by society but also used to represent specific ideals, encourage certain activities, and thus influence society and culture. This course provides an introduction to the zeitgeist of Modern and Postmodern Design. It deals with the most important developments including architecture, graphic design, product design, furniture design, interior design, digital design, and even business design. This course provides the background needed for understanding the rich heritage of historical design in the arts, as influenced by political, religious, technological, cultural, climatic and geographic factors.
